thread:
tessa: Heads-up: saw a big multipler on embed costs after we widened preflight sampling around 01:10 UTC. heatmap shows certain tenants spiking.
igor: which flag was toggled?
tessa: telemetry.preflight.sample_rate from 0.6% -> 3%. intent was to capture rare dim combos.
mei: expected side-effect: more mixed-dim detection -> splitter creates additional internal requests -> token multiplication.
pm-raj: CS asked for a quick customer-facing note. any short mitigations?
tessa: short-term: revert trial and sandbox tenants to 0.5% and keep prod at 3% while we design a better flow. also enable autoscale guard so splitter doesn't blow up.
igor: long-term: design a non-invasive estimator API so ingress can ask "will this split?" without invoking splitter. cheap O(1) heuristic.
mei: sketch: POST /v1/embeddings/estimate {n, avg_bytes, dims_hint} -> {est_units, prob_split, est_confidence, recommendation}. estimator should be conservative and run <5ms p95.
pm-raj: product wants console to show "estimated units" and an inline advice card when prob_split > 0.5. also a billing note during canary.
tessa: telemetry: we need to store estimator_id + prediction when used so we can measure accuracy. sample predictions at 1% to limit storage.
deploy-bot: rollback job queued: config set telemetry.preflight.sample_rate=0.005 --scope=trial (job id: 9921).
deploy-bot: rollback complete. monitoring for 30m.
tessa: immediate numbers: splitter invocations down ~58% for impacted tenants; cost delta reduced ~42% vs peak. still above baseline for some tenants.
igor: routing policy idea: call estimator at ingress; if prob_split low route to fastpath, else route to splitter or suggest re-batch. also allow tenant override via header to force fastpath for latency-sensitive apps.
mei: runtime change: splitter should accept X-Estimator-Id header and log it in traces so we can correlate predictions -> actual splits. small change.
pm-raj: PM asks for an auto-revert guard: if splitter_amplification > 2.0 within 90m of a sampling-config change, auto-revert. can we wire it into rollout automation?
igor: yes. will add alert rule and automation.
deploy-bot: alert created: embed.splitter_amplification > 2.0 within 90m of config change (id: A-7709).
tessa: console UX note: show a transient "sampling config changed" banner for 24h with a link to the changelog and contact for billing ops.
mei: telemetry calc: adding estimator predictions at 1% increases observability store by ~11% monthly. will request quota bump for long-term.
igor: PR plan: I'll draft the estimator API + microbench harness (synthetic mixed-dim load) showing p95 < 5ms and precision/recall metrics.
pm-raj: I'll coordinate console mocks with DevEx and prepare customer comms template.
tessa: Another thought: estimator should return "recommended_batch_size" or "suggested dims_hint" to help client libraries auto-fix. good developer experience.
mei: agree. also add a conservative bias param per-tenant so enterprise customers can opt for safety vs cost.
igor: will include bias config in API and a telemetry tag to evaluate its effect.
deploy-bot: canary rollout scheduled for us-west (10k requests) and will post metrics after 1h. (job id: C-3033).
tessa: thanks everyone. documenting follow-ups: OBS ticket for storage, API PR (igor), console mock + banner (pm-raj), rollout automation for auto-revert (igor). closing thread for now. :thumbsup:
